$comment: SPIN Selling — evidence rules. Riset empiris Huthwaite (35.000 calls): closing techniques gagal di large sale; needs dikembangkan lewat urutan pertanyaan; objections = simptom salah penjualan.

evidence_rules.condition: Evidence shows the price/offer is mentioned BEFORE the problem & implications of the problem are explicitly discussed, then the prospective client stops responding or says it’s expensive.
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS mentioning price or the offer EARLY — before the prospect's problem and its consequences were explicitly discussed — and the prospect then stalled, went quiet, or said it was too expensive.

consequence.rationale: Price without problem/implication context makes prospects evaluate the offer only by the number (SPIN research: needs must be developed before capability is demonstrated). Price objections = a symptom of the wrong sequence, not the wrong price.

evidence_rules.condition: user menggunakan closing techniques agresif (tekanan keputusan cepat, discount untuk hari ini, pertanyaan alternatif memaksa) padahal calon baru mengenalnya
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS using pressure-closing tactics (urgency pushes, today-only discounts, forced-choice questions) with prospects who are new or barely qualified.

consequence.rationale: Huthwaite research: closing techniques are NEGATIVELY correlated with success in large sales — they accelerate rejection and damage relationships. Frequent objections and rejections = symptoms of early closing.

evidence_rules.condition: Consistently high frequency of objections/rejections AND most offers mention features/services instead of results for the buyer
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS frequent price objections or rejections AND recounts offers framed around features/tasks of the work (deliverables, process) rather than outcomes the buyer gets.

consequence.rationale: SPIN research: objections are caused by salespeople who mention features/advantages too early. Benefits must be tied to the buyer's explicit problem — not a feature list.

evidence_rules.condition: user understands and can name specific problems + their implications as stated directly by prospective clients (not assumptions)
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS citing the prospect's own words about their problem and why it matters (quoted or paraphrased explicitly), distinguishing them from the user's own assumptions.

all_of.text_present_pattern: \b(dia bilang|kata dia|katanya|mereka bilang|jelas bilang|ucap|he said|she said|they said)\b

consequence.rationale: Masalah terverifikasi dari mulut pembeli = kualifikasi eksplisit (explicit need) tercapai — qualification failure menurun. Tier-1: sitasi kata kunci wajib.

evidence_rules.evaluation_note: Predicate mendeteksi bahasa kutipan pembeli; LLM matcher tetap membedakan kutipan asli vs parafrasa. Sitasi wajib.

evidence_rules.condition: Evidence shows the offer was framed as answers to needs the prospect already voiced; feature/advantage list appears only after an explicit need is on the table.
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS presenting benefits by linking them to the buyer's OWN stated explicit needs ('tadi Anda bilang…') instead of listing generic features or advantages.

consequence.rationale: Benefit yang dirangkai ke explicit need pembeli adalah satu-satunya bentuk 'benefit' yang berlaku di large sale (Huthwaite): fitur tanpa anchor kebutuhan memicu objeksi.

evidence_rules.condition: Objection arrives at the very start of the exchange, before needs development — a symptom of premature pitching rather than weak value.
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS receiving objections or push-back BEFORE any problem or its implications were discussed with that prospect.

consequence.rationale: Objection pre-problem menandakan pitch prematur: penjual datang dengan solusi sebelum masalah dikonfirmasi (SPIN: objections are seller-caused).

evidence_rules.condition: The buyer initiates movement toward the solution once consequences were made explicit — explicit needs are developed.
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS the prospect asking for details, pricing, or next steps AFTER implication and need-payoff questions were explored together.

consequence.rationale: Calon yang bergerak setelah implikasi dihitung bersama menandakan nilai terasa SEBELUM harga — kondisi ideal penjualan besar.

evidence_rules.condition: Call profile is situation-heavy: many background Q&A, zero or one problem statement — SPIN research links this profile to below-average success in large sales.
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS spending most of the conversation on situation questions (background facts) without surfacing any problem.

consequence.rationale: Situation questions berkorelasi negatif dengan sukses di large sale; mereka terindikasi kuat justru menutup pembeli (SP-A04).

evidence_rules.condition: Price/commitment request is sequenced after developed needs, and the prospect engaged with it rather than stalling.
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS asking for commitment or naming the price ONLY after the prospect articulated explicit needs and consequences.

consequence.rationale: Urutan harga-terakhir dengan needs terbangun = right commitment; keberhasilannya membuktikan value framing bekerja (SP-R01 cerminannya).

evidence_rules.condition: Escalating close techniques coincide with prospect retreat — the classic large-sale failure pattern.
evidence_rules.matcher_hint: The user RECOUNTS applying repeated closing pressure (urging, discounts, deadlines) in a large or high-uncertainty deal and the prospect withdrawing or going quiet.

consequence.rationale: Closing techniques berkorelasi NEGATIF dengan sukses di large sale (riset 35.000 calls); tekanan menandakan needs belum dikembangkan.
